title: Piron's later band compared with older bands
summary: Sidney Montague on drums; Dejan recalls Tio and earlier Piron-era players such as Steve Lewis.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: That's right. Did he use Sidney Montague to stay on drums?
Sidney Montague was playing drums during that time.
Oh, the old man. Yeah, that was after his time.
Yeah, he had a complete different band.
Yeah. Complete change, man. Complete change in the band.
In the old days, you'd have Peter Bogaj. Peter Bogaj.
Tio. Tio. Charlie Bogaj playing banjo. Albert Oney Grand Alto, saxophone.
There's a picture. Several pictures of that band has been printed. Some of them have been printed.
Yeah. Yeah. You ever worked with Steve Lewis?
No, I've never worked with Steve.
I never even got the hearing plane.
Except on records, you did make some records.
People, the people you'd be crazy about. Oh, yeah. I'd go with Tio on Saturday night sometimes and people crowd around. I don't care. I don't like that, huh?
